text:
alice: Heads-up — seeing a ~1.8% 502 spike for hosted-api (us-east-1) on /v1/stream starting ~08:02 UTC. Customers report aborted long-lived streams. Example request id: req_98f2a. Envoy line: "upstream reset before response". Can @bob @carlos take a look? :eyes:

bob: On it. Do we have a few trace ids and whether these are SSE/chunked connections or websockets?

alice: Mostly SSE / chunked streaming. Not huge payloads, but streams >3min more likely to hit 502. One trace id: trace-0xabc123. Repro curl below:

```curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-small" --data-binary @prompt.txt```

Also saw connection_queue_depth climb on frontdoor during spike (~1200).

dina: Filing a support ticket for the impacted customers and attaching the trace. Observability shows frontdoor h2_keepalive_pool sat at ~100% at the time.

carlos: Quick look at edge logs: multiple upstream connect failures + h2 stream resets. Sample envoy snippet:

```
[2026-03-17T08:03:11.123Z] "POST /v1/stream" 502 - upstream reset before response, reset_reason=connection_failure, upstream_host=10.4.2.12:8443, req_id=req_98f2a
```

This looks like h2 keepalive / connection pool exhaustion under sustained long-lived streams causing upstream connect failures. Trying a canary tweak to h2_keepalive_pool size and short-lived retry at the edge.

deploy-bot: Canary patch deployed to us-east-1 at 08:15 UTC: increased h2_keepalive_pool from 256 -> 512 for frontdoor canary nodes.

bob: Early metric after canary: 502 rate down from 1.8% -> 0.3% over 10m window. Connection_queue_depth is back to baseline. Adding an edge-side 502 retry with jitter as stopgap.

alice: Great — please add notes for customers (support ticket updated). We'll keep the canary up for 2h then roll cluster-wide if stable. If any teams see new regressions flag here. :thumbsup:
